title: STL-Like Mesh Measurement (Surface Area and Volume)
prompt:
Use Three.js to display a programmatically generated “STL-like” triangular mesh and provide measurements and annotations.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following import map in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { CSS2DRenderer, CSS2DObject } from 'three/addons/renderers/CSS2DRenderer.js';
</script>

[Mesh]
(1) Use IcosahedronGeometry subdivided to exactly 320 triangular faces (faceCount=320), and use it as an exported BufferGeometry.
(2) It may be scaled and centered to approximately unit scale.

[Measurement]
(3) Point-to-point distance: Click two points on the mesh surface in sequence (obtain each 3D point by interpolating on the triangular face hit by the Raycaster), and display the Euclidean distance; append the result to the measurements array (for example, { type:'distance', value, a, b }).
(4) Surface area: Calculate surfaceArea by summing over the triangular faces (display it in the UI and synchronize it with __3D_STATE__).
(5) Volume: Obtain estimatedVolume for the closed mesh by accumulating signed volumes or by approximation.

[Annotations]
(6) Use CSS2DRenderer + CSS2DObject to display text labels at 3D positions; the annotations array records the current annotation metadata (id, text, position, etc.).

[State Exposure (Required)]
window.__3D_STATE__ = {
  faceCount: number,
  vertexCount: number,
  measurements: Array,
  surfaceArea: number,
  estimatedVolume: number,
  annotations: Array
}

faceCount must always be 320; surfaceArea and estimatedVolume must be finite positive numbers.

Output a single HTML file that can be run by opening it directly in a browser.
